content:
It's time to take a look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple has released new silicone and TechWoven series in matching colors, alongside our tried-and-true favorite picks from major third-party brands over the years. From a brand new burgundy option with built-in stand, to ultra-grippy customizable models, to premium leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods — there's something for everyone. We also have super affordable options starting from $14 from budget brands like Spigen.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Updated 9/27: Added an additional promo code exclusive to 9to5 readers below.

Apple

Featured Brand: ESR

ESR's brand new iPhone 18 Pro case and accessory lineup has arrived, featuring high-quality color craftsmanship, patented technology, and more highlights. The star of this new collection is the latest Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with a built-in zinc-alloy Flex Stand tucked within the camera module protection area, offering 3x military-grade protection, and a "soft, flexible, comfortable grip." Like other accessories, the new Atelier is available in four colors to perfectly complement the new Burgundy, Glacial, Black, and Silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand $42 (reg. $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Wallet with Stand (Grip) $46 (reg. $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

When it comes to leather cases, Nomad is at the top of the industry, and all of their flagship models are now available for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year, they've also introduced a new Rugged Case series, with each color featuring a topographic map pattern of Baja California:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 – $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 – $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Brand: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready to launch their ever-popular Grip Case for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Beyond the signature clean design and ultra-grippy texture, you can continue to customize your look with a vast selection of body skins, and bundle with a compatible Prism screen protector for a discount.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $55 Customizable, drop protection, ultra-grippy texture, crisp button response
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 Screen Protector (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) 2-pack $35 ($5 off when bundled with a case) Easy install, auto-alignment, fully dust-proof

This year, Dbrand has also launched the new MNML case series, starting from $39, featuring a minimalist sleek design, more affordable pricing, MagSafe support, and retaining the brand's signature addictive crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Navy, Tan, Burgundy

Bluebonnet

Bluebonnet is a small shop that started in Texas, USA, crafting some of the best leather cases on the market with premium full-grain leather and a minimalist edge-to-edge design (absolutely no plastic components) plus copper-plated metal buttons. We've also secured an exclusive 20% off deal for 9to5 readers on the new iPhone 18 Pro models:

  • Minimalist Full-Grain Leather iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Case $63 (reg. $79) Use code 9to5 at checkout

UAG

UAG has also launched a range of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max simultaneously, including their signature rugged options with thick corner protection, grippy bezels, and various drop-focused designs. If you like heavy-duty use and prioritize everyday protection, UAG's lineup is definitely worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve $65 for iPhone Duo
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
  • UAG Civilian Anti-Slip Case from $60
  • And more…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Cases

If you're looking for a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want the usual suspects like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut series is worth considering. These cases pass MIL-STD-810H drop testing, offer reliable protection, support MagSafe, and have a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you want something more premium but not too bulky for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't miss Mous. Beyond the featured options below, you can also currently get ultra-thin Aramid Fiber cases designed specifically for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fibre Case $70
  • And more…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases lean more into design, standing out from the crowd with futuristic sleek silhouettes paired with textured finishes.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case $60 for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

If you're looking for a thinner case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, PITAKA's offerings are for you. Their cases typically use lightweight Aramid Fiber paired with a clean minimalist look, while retaining MagSafe compatibility and reinforced protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Woven Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protective Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox already has multiple iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases available, ranging from slim everyday options to ultra-rugged designs, catering to your need for solid protection. Many of the new models also support MagSafe, with some options adding extras like grippy sides, accessory holders, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, so you can pick flexibly based on your desired thickness and protection level.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And more…

Belkin

Belkin is also a solid choice for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially if you're looking for something cleaner that isn't as bulky as a full-on rugged case. Their lineup generally includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases, with raised edges for the screen and camera, and some models (like Protect+) even feature reinforced corner designs, striking a good balance between everyday protection and a slim appearance.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2 MagSafe-Compatible Grip Case $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case (with Airbag Impact Corners) $60

CASETiFY

CASETiFY is another brand that typically rolls out new iPhone cases quickly, and their iPhone 18 Pro series lineup is already here with plenty of options. The brand is best known for colorful designs, bold patterns, and protective cases that don't look too dull. Most options in the series support MagSafe, with models focusing on clear, drop protection, and more fashionable styles.

  • CASETiFY Ripple Silicone Case $56
  • CASETiFY Impact Ring Stand Case $64
  • CASETiFY Mirror Case with MagSafe $64
  • And more…

Speck

Speck's iPhone 18 Pro series continues the brand's signature minimalist design ethos, focusing on everyday protection. The series includes several slim, grippy cases, as well as MagSafe-compatible models, and clear options that let the original color of your device show through. These cases offer solid drop protection without making your phone feel too bulky.

  • Speck Presidio Clear Grip Case $50 for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • Speck Presidio 2 Grip ClickLock Case with MagSafe $50
  • Speck CandyShell Icon Case with MagSafe $40
  • And more…

elago

elago cases lean toward a clean and sleek design aesthetic, with more affordable pricing than other brands. The lineup generally includes slim silicone, clear, and MagSafe-compatible options in simple colors that complement Apple's device colorways nicely.

  • elago Urban Clear Case $14 (reg. $16)
  • elago Pebble Case $15 (reg. $17)
  • elago Ring Stand Armor Case $19 (reg. $25)
  • elago Ridge Silicone Case $19
  • And more…
